name: @amykit/plugin-telegram
description: A topic per piece of work in the operator's private chat with a Telegram bot, as the conversation port.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when you want to follow and answer amy from Telegram. It mounts the conversation port: each piece of work gets a topic in your private chat with a bot, and it can also hold amy's chat. It needs the bot token in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and your numeric Telegram user id.
